description:
Convert the following Java files to Kotlin using Android Studio's 'Convert Java File to Kotlin File' feature:

1. app/src/main/java/com/example/roomwordsample/Word.java
2. app/src/main/java/com/example/roomwordsample/WordDao.java
3. app/src/main/java/com/example/roomwordsample/WordViewModel.java

Ensure that:
- The resulting files are valid Kotlin (.kt).
- Room annotations (@Entity, @Dao, etc.) are preserved.
- Nullability issues (if any) are resolved.
- The project builds successfully after conversion.

Do NOT convert the other Java files (MainActivity, Repository, etc.).

To verify your work, run 'Build > Make Project' or './gradlew assembleDebug'.
